companies.name: Avosano AG (formerly Voigt AG)
companies.distributes: Pharmaceutical, dietary and cosmetic products as a full range wholesaler; about 32,000 articles held in stock.
companies.channels_supplied: Pharmacies, drugstores, medical suppliers and health food stores across German-speaking Switzerland, including Eastern Switzerland. Sister wholesaler Amedis belongs to the same Avosano holding.
companies.fit_rationale: A Thurgau based wholesaler next to St. Gallen that reaches pharmacies, drugstores and health food stores, the channel where diabetic and sugar-free lines sell. Its registered purpose covers dietary products, but a confectionery range is not confirmed, so check first whether it lists food lines.
what_they_do_well: Family business founded in 1904 that keeps 32,000 articles in stock and delivers within three hours.

companies.name: F.P. Selection Group AG
companies.distributes: Food products of all kinds, especially imported and exported specialities from Italy, Switzerland and the Mediterranean region (registered purpose since 2022).
companies.fit_rationale: A small St. Gallen importer of Mediterranean specialities that could add a sugar-free sweet range to what it sells. It is confirmed only from the commercial register, and its customers and whether it holds stock are unknown.

companies.name: Arnold Produkte AG
companies.distributes: Food trading and transport (registered purpose); listed as a wholesale distributor of food, beverages and tobacco.
companies.fit_rationale: A long established Thurgau food trader with its own transport, close to the St. Gallen market. Its range and customers could not be confirmed, so treat it as a lead to qualify.
what_they_do_well: Trading in food since its commercial register entry in 1988.

companies.name: Frommis Delikatessen GmbH
companies.distributes: Fish, delicatessen and food of all kinds, with beverage trade, food processing and catering.
companies.fit_rationale: A newly registered St. Gallen delicatessen wholesaler that might add premium better-for-you sweets. It is very new and its focus is fish and catering, so fit is uncertain.
